Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.util.ArrayList;
public class UniqueDigitsCount {
    public static int uniqueDigitsCount(int input1) {
        ArrayList<Integer> nums = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        while (input1 != 0){
            int digit = input1 % 10;
            if (!nums.contains(digit)) nums.add(digit);
            input1 /= 10;
        }
        return nums.size();
    }
}
